title: SimpleArchiver
description: This simple mod gives you the ability to zip and compress your files with a command.
body:
# SimpleArchiver
## Preface
This simple mod was created for the sake of my practice in creating mods. This mod does not have any practical use, but you can just play around with it.
## How to use
The main mod command is /archive.

The syntax of the command is /archive “pathToSourceFile” “pathToNewZipFile”.

Example - /archive "C:/Users/user/Pictures/archives/picture.png" "C:/Users/user/Pictures/archives/picture.zip"

**IMPORTANT!!!! Command arguments must necessarily be in quotation marks**
